title: [ingest] Semantic duplicate warnings require a 0.85 cosine score
summary: The semantic duplicate threshold is `0.85`, well above the looser relatedness cutoff. The code treats this as near-paraphrase territory, so duplicate warnings only fire on very strong matches.
